title: Níwájú ìtẹ́ àánú
review_notes: All four verses visible in user photograph. Spellings and tone marks standardized provisionally; needs a final orthographic pass.
verses: Ẹni tí a pa fún wa
Tó sì tún ń padà bọ̀.
Títí la ó máa yin Ọ
A ó sì ṣe Ọ l'Ọba.
verses_en: We give Thee praise and glory,
Dear Lord, it is so sweet.
Who once for us was slain;
Thou livest and reignest in glory,
Thou set Thy love upon us,
To Thee be all the praise.
And crown Thee King of kings.
